SELECT NVL((SELECT DEAL_ID FROM TB_HOTDEAL_TRACKER WHERE ORIGIN_URL = #{originUrl}), 0) FROM DUAL
MERGE INTO TB_HOTDEAL_TRACKER t USING DUAL ON (t.ORIGIN_URL = #{originUrl}) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET t.TITLE = #{title}, t.CURRENT_PRICE = #{currentPrice}, t.IMAGE_URL = #{imageUrl}, t.LAST_UPDATE_DATE = SYSDATE WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (ORIGIN_URL, TITLE, IMAGE_URL, CURRENT_PRICE, START_PRICE, MALL_NAME, COMMUNITY_NAME, LAST_UPDATE_DATE) VALUES (#{originUrl}, #{title}, #{imageUrl}, #{currentPrice}, #{currentPrice}, #{mallName}, #{communityName}, SYSDATE)
INSERT INTO TB_PRICE_HISTORY (DEAL_ID, PRICE, RECORD_DATE) VALUES (#{dealId}, #{price}, SYSDATE)
mapper.select: SELECT DEAL_ID FROM TB_HOTDEAL_TRACKER WHERE ORIGIN_URL = #{originUrl}

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT DEAL_ID as dealId, ORIGIN_URL as originUrl, TITLE as title, IMAGE_URL as imageUrl, CURRENT_PRICE as currentPrice, START_PRICE as startPrice, MALL_NAME as mallName, COMMUNITY_NAME as communityName, LAST_UPDATE_DATE as lastUpdateDate FROM TB_HOTDEAL_TRACKER ORDER BY LAST_UPDATE_DATE DESC ) WHERE rownum <= 10

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT rownum rnum, a.* FROM ( SELECT DEAL_ID as dealId, ORIGIN_URL as originUrl, TITLE as title, IMAGE_URL as imageUrl, CURRENT_PRICE as currentPrice, START_PRICE as startPrice, MALL_NAME as mallName, COMMUNITY_NAME as communityName, LAST_UPDATE_DATE as lastUpdateDate FROM TB_HOTDEAL_TRACKER ORDER BY LAST_UPDATE_DATE DESC ) a WHERE rownum <= #{pageEnd} ) WHERE rnum >= #{pageStart}

SELECT DEAL_ID as dealId, TITLE as title, CURRENT_PRICE as currentPrice, IMAGE_URL as imageUrl, ORIGIN_URL as originUrl, MALL_NAME as mallName, START_PRICE as startPrice, LAST_UPDATE_DATE as lastUpdateDate FROM TB_HOTDEAL_TRACKER WHERE DEAL_ID = #{dealId}
SELECT TO_CHAR(RECORD_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS REG_DATE, PRICE FROM TB_PRICE_HISTORY WHERE DEAL_ID = #{dealId} ORDER BY RECORD_DATE ASC

SELECT DEAL_ID as dealId, TITLE as title, CURRENT_PRICE as currentPrice, START_PRICE as startPrice, MALL_NAME as mallName, ORIGIN_URL as originUrl, LAST_UPDATE_DATE as lastUpdateDate FROM TB_HOTDEAL_TRACKER WHERE DEAL_ID = #{dealId}
SELECT PRICE, RECORD_DATE AS REGDATE FROM TB_PRICE_HISTORY WHERE DEAL_ID = #{dealId} ORDER BY RECORD_DATE DESC

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT t.DEAL_ID as "dealId", t.TITLE as "title", t.CURRENT_PRICE as "currentPrice", h.PRICE as "prevPrice", ROUND(((t.CURRENT_PRICE - h.PRICE) / h.PRICE) * 100, 1) as "dropRate" FROM TB_HOTDEAL_TRACKER t JOIN ( -- 가장 최근 이력 하나 전의 가격을 가져오기 위한 조인 SELECT DEAL_ID, PRICE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY DEAL_ID ORDER BY RECORD_DATE DESC) as rn FROM TB_PRICE_HISTORY ) h ON t.DEAL_ID = h.DEAL_ID WHERE h.rn = 2 -- 1은 현재가와 같으므로, 2번째(이전 수집가)와 비교 AND t.CURRENT_PRICE < h.PRICE -- 가격이 떨어진 것만 ORDER BY "dropRate" ASC -- 하락폭이 큰 순서 (-20%가 -10%보다 작으므로 ASC) ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 10
SELECT t.TITLE as "title", t.CURRENT_PRICE as "price" FROM TB_HOTDEAL_TRACKER t WHERE t.CURRENT_PRICE = ( SELECT MIN(PRICE) FROM TB_PRICE_HISTORY h WHERE h.DEAL_ID = t.DEAL_ID ) AND ROWNUM <= 5
